calibration.note: Calibration was fitted on ID_VAL only. A validation-only gain is NOT evidence of improved OOD performance; OOD metrics are reported separately from a distinct, untouched split. Temperature scaling and a constant class logit shift preserve the within-class logit ordering and cannot manufacture class separation that the representation lacks.

default rationale [loss]: focal down-weights easy examples; --loss ce --class-weight balanced gives standard balanced CE
default rationale [class_weight]: weights n/(K*count) are computed from TRAIN labels only
default rationale [early_metric]: balanced_accuracy prevents a collapsed single-class model from being checkpointed
default rationale [temperature_calibration]: temperature (+ logit adjustment) fitted on ID_VAL only; never on OOD
default rationale [balanced_sampler]: off by default to avoid triple correction; opt in with --balanced-sampler
